name: io.github.kochetkov-ma/brewpage-mcp
title: BrewPage MCP
description: Publish HTML, Markdown, sites, KV, JSON and files on BrewPage; keep the returned owner token.

environmentVariables.name: BREWPAGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override API base URL. Defaults to https://brewpage.app.

environmentVariables.name: BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional default owner token for every call; unset = new token per create.
